QUESTION_TO_RESOLVE: Does the approved methodology recognize one exact, completed, family-specific structural primitive whose MOTIVE_FIVE_WAVE_FAMILY or CORRECTIVE_THREE_WAVE_FAMILY status can be established without any nested CertifiedValidatedInternalFamily input; if so, what deterministic conditions define it?
WHY_REQUIRED: Every documented nonterminal family form requires motive and/or corrective child-family proof. Without one protected primitive, the empty family registry cannot issue its first certificate and recursion has no positive finite terminus.
CURRENT_CONFLICT_OR_SILENCE: SOURCE_SILENCE. The corpus defines unresolved handling when internals are concealed but neither defines nor conflicts about a positive terminal primitive.
MINIMUM_ACCEPTABLE_SOURCE_STATEMENT: Explicitly name exactly one qualifying primitive and exactly one existing family kind it proves.
State that within a precisely bounded scope the primitive is structurally complete and does not require deeper family-certificate proof.
Define observable, deterministic qualification inputs and conditions; a label, visual impression, or matching cardinality is insufficient.
Define the primitive-local completion event or condition so completion is not caller asserted.
State that nested family proof stops at this primitive and nowhere else.
State how NOT_VISIBLE and UNKNOWN required internals remain unresolved under P023.
Define positive, violated, and unresolved machine boundaries, including malformed or missing input behavior.
REQUIRED_SCOPE: Family kind: exactly MOTIVE_FIVE_WAVE_FAMILY or CORRECTIVE_THREE_WAVE_FAMILY.
Primitive pattern/form and any allowed direction, degree, asset, instrument, and data-resolution scope.
Exact analyzed-subject identity and observation provenance to which the determination belongs.
Whether the primitive is universal or limited to a named source context.
Whether completion is intrinsic to the primitive or separately evidenced.
REQUIRED_EXCEPTIONS: Caller-declared family, completion, position, or endpoints.
Unsupported asset, direction, degree, or observation-resolution scope.
Any pattern-specific exception the source intends to permit.

REQUIRED_MACHINE_DECISION_BOUNDARY.positive: All explicitly required primitive conditions and primitive-local completion evidence are present for the exact subject; no nested family certificate is required only because the source expressly makes this form terminal.
REQUIRED_MACHINE_DECISION_BOUNDARY.violated: A source-defined compulsory primitive condition is conclusively false for the exact subject.
REQUIRED_MACHINE_DECISION_BOUNDARY.unresolved: Inputs, visibility, completion, scope, or required observation authority are absent, unknown, malformed, or not source-defined.
REQUIRED_MACHINE_DECISION_BOUNDARY.p023: NOT_VISIBLE or UNKNOWN never maps to positive.
REQUIRED_MACHINE_DECISION_BOUNDARY.fatality: Must be explicitly stated by source classification and scope; it cannot be inferred merely from producer status.

WHAT_WOULD_NOT_BE_SUFFICIENT: An unlabeled example or diagram without an explicit terminal proposition.
Statements that a structure looks clear, simple, typical, usual, or small.
A fixed timeframe, smallest observable degree, exhausted feed, or recursion limit.
Three or five visible swings or matching direct-child cardinality.
Caller, analyst, model, or generic AI judgment.
A completion assertion without a source-defined observable boundary.
A statement requiring an already validated member of the same empty family as its own prerequisite.
DOWNSTREAM_BEHAVIORS_UNLOCKED: One first family-specific terminal producer and certificate issuance path.
Nested-family input availability for the pattern compositions that consume the selected family kind.
A finite anchor for later recursive INTERNALS_CONFIRMED propagation, after separate aggregation semantics are approved.
